_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil statistics and neutral funding/30d momentum keep the score inside Denial; no breaker named to force Panic or Anxiety.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on phase Denial and non-directional stance; narrative offers no competing forward call
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear_greed holds 32-38 and 30d momentum stays near flat through the Sunday/first-3 window without a >1.5% impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: A >2% downside break with fear_greed under 32 (Panic) or a sustained push lifting the score above 39 (Anxiety)
